coordinator_goal_review: No conflict identified: target-caused reproduction before change, truthful unavailable/retrospective evidence, suitable non-executable comparisons/derivations, neutral tools/languages/hosts, preservation and prohibition on manufactured failures.
remaining_risks: Longer first-step guidance may reduce salience.

Before changing implementation is broader than before applying a fix; selected exact text is not silently narrowed.
Guidance cannot ensure initial activation; binding/selection and reminder salience confound causal attribution.
Cross-panel B1/B2 anchor variability preserved; no rescoring to threshold.
